name: Character Detail — open detail modal and view skills
description: Verify clicking on a character card in the catalog opens the character detail modal displaying combat stats, skills and radar chart.

planSteps.description: Click the Personagens (Characters) item in the sidebar to open the catalog
Click the first character card in the catalog grid
Verify the character detail modal opens over the screen, showing the character art, attributes (HP, Taijutsu, Jujutsu), and vertical tabs for combat skills and ultimate technique
